chunks: 且从他，从艾哈迈德和阿卜杜拉，穆罕默德·本·伊萨之子，从阿里·本·哈卡姆，从阿卜杜拉·本·布凯尔，从祖拉勒，从阿布·贾法尔（愿主福安之）传述，他说：
艾布·胡莱赖传述：先知说："当夜间过半时，你们中有人应当起身，以十三拜的奇数拜进行礼拜。然后，如果他愿意，可以坐下祈祷；如果他愿意，可以睡觉；如果他愿意，可以随意去做他想做的事。"
且推荐这两拜之后不睡觉，并忙于祈祷和赞颂，因为此时睡觉确为可憎。
ai.seo_question: what is the number of rak'ahs in the night prayer and what should one do after completing it?
ai.summary: attributed to imam al-baqir (as), this hadith establishes the canonical structure of the thirteen-rak'ah night prayer, emphasizing the spiritual significance of the time after midnight (wusta al-layl). while it permits flexibility in post-prayer). while it permits flexibility in post-prayer conduct, shia jurisprudence highlights the preference for remaining in a state of devotion through supplication and dhikr rather than sleeping, reflecting the tradition of the ahl al-bayt's nocturnal worship.
